footnotes.text: The scriptures share several examples of fathers doing this with their descendants as they aged. For example, see the counsel of Lehi in2 Nephi 1–3and King Benjamin inMosiah 1:2–17.

“Human intimacy is reserved for a married couple because it is the ultimate symbol of total union, a totality and a union ordained and defined by God” (Jeffrey R. Holland, “Personal Purity,”Liahona, Jan. 1999, 91).
